mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month rolling average indicates economic contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25 percentage points over a 3-month period signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a severe economic contraction, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates aggressive policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and HOUST falls > 5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (as defined by UNRATE above 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a recovery in the labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0% and declines by more than 0.1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) relative to its 12-month average signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 137,000 thousand units signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS < 137000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) below their 12-month averages signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS are both below their 12-month rolling averages.
